sentences.en: There are many ways to improve your English, for instance by reading books.
sentences.zh: 提高英语有很多方法，例如通过读书。

sentences.en: We have several options for the meeting time; for instance, we could meet at 3 PM.
sentences.zh: 我们有几个开会的时间选择；比如说可以在下午三点半。

sentences.en: He likes various sports activities, for instance playing basketball and swimming.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢各种体育活动，例如打篮球和游泳。
